answer_1.quote: We presented FILM, a neural LM with an interpretable symbolically bound fact memory. We demonstrated the effectiveness of this method by outperforming many state-of-the-art methods on four benchmark knowledge intensive datasets.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs are predicted entities in response to cloze-style or open-domain questions, such as answering "United Kingdom" as the answer to a masked mention in a passage.
